content: RESOLUTION of entourage open thread + ledger self-test (3-system deep synthesis 2026-05-18). Original worry: am I letting a thin human null (Cooper 2013) override a rich mechanistic signal -- the mirror image of the error the tiered ledger exists to prevent? Resolution: the worry dissolves because the rich mechanistic floor is ITSELF negative. Santiago et al. 2019: six terpenoids, no modulation of THC/CBD radioligand displacement or functional signaling at human CB1/CB2 in heterologous expression. Heblinski et al. 2020: same terpene panel, no modulation of THC/AEA/capsaicin at TRPA1/TRPV1. Evidence is concordant-negative ACROSS tiers (human RCT + rigorous in vitro), so hypothesis-not-proof is not a thin-null overriding mechanism -- it is the honest read. Ledger self-test PASSED: the discipline held because I checked whether mechanism contradicted the clinical null rather than assuming it did. Preserved caveat: absence at CB1/CB2/TRPA1/TRPV1 does not disprove unmapped targets; limonene+THC anxiety-mitigation is real proof-of-concept for SPECIFIC interactions, not broad synergy.
